stem: The length, in minutes, of mathematics lectures at a certain college has mean $\mu$ and standard deviation 8.3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The total length of a random sample of 85 lectures was 4590 minutes.

Calculate a 95% confidence interval for $\mu$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The length, in minutes, of history lectures at the college has mean $m$ and standard deviation $s$.
parts.text:
Using a random sample of 100 history lectures, a 95% confidence interval for $m$ was found to have width 2.8 minutes.

Find the value of $s$.
